response.sql: WITH film_copies AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS num_copies FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating), rating_avg AS (SELECT rating, AVG(num_copies) AS avg_copies_for_rating FROM film_copies GROUP BY rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(num_copies) AS avg_copies_overall FROM film_copies) SELECT fc.film_id, fc.rating, fc.num_copies, fc.num_copies - ra.avg_copies_for_rating AS diff_from_rating_avg, fc.num_copies - oa.avg_copies_overall AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM film_copies fc CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa JOIN rating_avg ra ON fc.rating = ra.rating ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
